kings1.5.p1.b1.text: Now when Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king in his father’s place, he sent envoys to Solomon; for Hiram had always been a friend of David.

kings1.5.p1.b2.text: As you are well aware, due to the wars waged on all sides against my father David, he could not build a house for the Name of the LORD his God …

kings1.5.p1.b3.text: So behold, I plan to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God …

kings1.5.p2.b1.text: Now therefore, order that cedars of Lebanon be cut down for me. … for you know that there are none among us as skilled in logging as the Sidonians.

kings1.5.p2.b2.text: Blessed be the LORD this day! He has given David a wise son over this great people!

kings1.5.p2.b3.text: … I will do all you desire regarding the cedar and cypress timber.

kings1.5.p3.b1.text: My servants will haul the logs from Lebanon to the Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. …

kings1.5.p3.b2.text: and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, as well as 20,000 baths of pure olive oil.

kings1.5.p3.b3.text: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.

kings1.5.p4.b1.text: Then King Solomon conscripted a labor force of 30,000 men from all Israel. He sent them to Lebanon in monthly shifts of 10,000 men …

kings1.5.p4.b2.text: … so that they would spend one month in Lebanon and two months at home.

kings1.5.p4.b3.text: And Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.

kings1.5.p4.b4.text: Solomon had 70,000 porters and 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains, not including his 3,300 foremen who supervised the workers.

kings1.5.p5.b1.text: And the king commanded them to quarry large, costly stones to lay the foundation of the temple with dressed stones.

kings1.5.p5.b2.text: So Solomon’s and Hiram’s builders, along with the Gebalites, quarried the stone …

kings1.5.p5.b3.text: … and prepared the timber and stone for the construction of the temple.
